files.purpose: Pure math for the white damage trail behind a health bar.
Thin MonoBehaviour that shows names, portraits and health bars with damage trails in the match.
HUD layout: player block top-left, CPU block top-right, middle free.
Clean Retro HUD styles using the Style Guide palette.
EditMode tests for the damage-trail math.

integration_notes: Create a HUD prefab (Assets/Prefabs/UI/MatchHud.prefab) or scene object in Match.unity with UIDocument (Source Asset = Assets/UI/MatchHud.uxml, PanelSettings = Assets/UI/RuralRumblePanelSettings.asset) and the MatchHud component. Default execution order (do not set it earlier than MatchBootstrap).
Tune Trail Hold Seconds (0.4) and Trail Drain Seconds (0.5) in the MatchHud Inspector.
HealthTrailTests need the EditMode test assembly to reference RuralRumble.UI (and UnityEngine for Mathf via the default engine reference).
MatchHud.cs needs RuralRumble.UI to reference RuralRumble.Core, Combat, and Match (already listed). UI Toolkit modules are referenced by default.
Sort order: if other UIDocuments are in the Match scene (timer, versus banner), give each its own sort order; this HUD's root ignores pointer picking.
assumptions: CombatMatch.Player and CombatMatch.Cpu are typed as or convertible to IWrestlerView, and CombatMatch.Events is a CombatEvents (as used by MatchFlow/MatchBootstrap).
The white trail uses pure #FFFFFF rather than the palette off-white #E6DFCC so it reads as white.
Player bar is blue (#2872B8) and CPU bar red (#C7352C); designer should confirm.
The bars are sized by a percent width on the fill and trail; the CPU bar drains toward the right (mirrored).
Diamond portraits are made by rotating a square 45 degrees; the portrait is cropped to fill (scale-and-crop) and may clip its corners.
Initial fallback uses the first character of DisplayName in uppercase in palette yellow.
